\caption{\textbf{End-to-end benchmark on EMPIAR-10164.}
Each method starts from the same particle picks and is shown at two stages: before and after the per-image corrections of optics, tilt geometry and particle motion.
Columns 2--4 give the cross-FSC (\cref{sec:results:setup}): each half map of a method against the opposite half map of the polished RELION-5 reconstruction, computed from the other half of the particles.
The two values are half 1 and half 2.
In the last row the two compared maps are RELION's own half maps, so both values are equal and give RELION's standard resolution estimate.
Column 5 compares the average of the two half maps with the deposited atomic model (PDB 5L93).
All maps are scored by the same procedure.
Bold marks the better value of the two methods at each stage.
STAGS times are wall-clock times from the picks on two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs.
$^\dagger$4.33\,h when initial particle extraction and scoring are included.
